capabilities: fetch merge requests, mentions, and todos from the GitLab API on a configurable interval
show a categorized sidebar inbox with status badges, action buttons, and batch Done/Snooze
write a persistent checklist note with check-off state that survives refreshes
auto-prioritize items via configurable label rules and clean up stale todos
log checked-off items into the daily note and show a status bar count
extras: The access token is stored locally in data.json; the README warns to add it to .gitignore if the vault is synced via git. Installation is manual (copy main.js, manifest.json, styles.css) rather than through the community plugin browser.
problem: Obsidian has no way to surface pending GitLab code-review work inside the vault, so review queues and todos must be tracked outside it.

relations.evidence: connects to your configured GitLab instance (self-hosted or gitlab.com) via authenticated HTTPS requests
Obsidian Tasks plugin (recommended, for checkbox integration with TODO.md)

requires.name: GitLab personal access token with api scope

summary: GitLab review-inbox plugin that fetches MRs, mentions, and todos on a schedule and tracks them in a sidebar and a check-off note.
